verdict.rationale: Manufact's Gateway Requests view logs every request flowing through the gateway in near real-time, and platform engineers can toggle payload capture to store full request/response bodies for audit purposes (manufact-docs-12, manufact-docs-13, manufact-docs-30). However, there is no documented replay capability or long-term retention/export detail, and no mention of correlating logs to specific agent sessions for reconstructing an action sequence. missing for 10: explicit replay/re-execution of captured tool calls, retention/export guarantees, and per-agent/session correlation in logs.
